bokeh_shape — OPTICS lensrender op

• 数据种类:table → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.bokeh_shape(system, field_xy_mm=None, defocus_mm=0.5, pupil_samples=512, object_mm=None, wavelength_um=None, grid=64) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import lensrender; lensrender.bokeh_shape(system, field_xy_mm=None, defocus_mm=0.5, pupil_samples=512, object_mm=None, wavelength_um=None, grid=64) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsoptics.get("bokeh_shape"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

点光源失焦像(虚化)的形状——光瞳像的交集,即猫眼形 -> 字典。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

The point sits at *field_xy_mm* in the object plane at *object_mm* (a height in mm; for an object at infinity a pair of angles in degrees;

default: (0, 8) degrees for an object at infinity, a height of 5 % of the object distance otherwise), the sensor is *defocus_mm* behind the system's image plane. A hexapolar pupil bundle of about *pupil_samples* rays is traced forward (raytrace.ray_bundle, which stops a ray at every semi-diameter); the rays that get through land on the shifted sensor and their convex hull is the footprint. The table has polygon_xy_mm (the hull, counter-clockwise, relative to its centroid, on the sensor axes), mask (a grid x grid boolean image of the footprint, extent_mm wide), area_mm2, the same for the on-axis point (axis_area_mm2), area_ratio (cat's eye / on-axis disc), vignetting_factor (the share of the pupil area that gets through relative to the axis, from the ray bundle), n_valid, centroid_xy_mm, symmetry_error_mm (how far the footprint is from its mirror image about the meridional plane, 0 in exact arithmetic) and the footprint points points_xy_mm. The geometric defocus disc of a point on axis has the diameter 2 |defocus| NA' (tested). The system must be axisymmetric (the field is traced along +y and rotated).

该族通用的输入契约(fail-closed)

optics 的每个算子都先校验输入再计算(不让任何东西无声通过):

• 单位写进参数名 —— _mm / _um / _deg / _mrad。把 mm 和 µm 弄混不会崩溃,而是给出「看着合理却是错的答案」,所以用命名来防。这里绝不从数值大小去猜单位。

• 字符串一律 ValueError —— float('50') 会成功,于是未解析的配置值会被当成长度混进来(实测:thin_lens('50', '200') 曾返回看着合理的 66.667 mm)。bool 也按 True == 1 的隐式提升拒绝。

• complex / masked array 一律 ValueError(仅接受实数槽位;拒绝无声丢弃虚部或剥掉掩码)。所有输入中的 NaN/Inf 一律 ValueError。

• 逐项点名拒绝除零及其近亲:焦距 0、曲率半径 0、折射率 <= 0、全不透明光阑(全为 0,归一化变成 0/0)、总和 <= 0 的 PSF、S0 = 0 的 Stokes 矢量、物体位于前焦点(像在无穷远)。

• 只有两个算子会返回非有限值,而且都写进了契约:depth_of_field 在超焦距以外返回 far_mm = inf(这正是超焦距的定义),gaussian_beam 在束腰处返回 wavefront_radius_mm = inf(平面波前的曲率半径)。两者都同时返回一个有限的搭档(far_is_infinite / curvature_per_mm)。除此之外的无声 NaN/Inf 都在内部检出并 ValueError ——「float64 溢出了」和「答案是无穷大」是两种不同的主张,不能拿后者的脸去交付前者。

• 尺寸上限:生成网格受 optics.MAX_GRID(4096)限制,传入的场/PSF/光阑受 optics.MAX_FIELD_ELEMENTS(2^24),ABCD 元件序列受 optics.MAX_SYSTEM_ELEMENTS(1024),Zernike 受 MAX_ZERNIKE_TERMS(512)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_ORDER(40)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_BASIS(2^25)。以 fail-closed 堵住「小参数引发巨大内部分配」的路径(实测:n_max=40 × 4096² 需要 108 GB)。

• 物理上不可能的状态同样拒绝:偏振度 > 1 的 Stokes 矢量、负透过率、负强度、n-|m| 为奇数等非法 Zernike 指标。
